Case reference: 2023055905.CaseDesc: On October 9, 2023, Robert Sam (Whitey) McKEAN was reported missing in Whistler, British Columbia. Robert was walking his dog Lexi, a 15-year-old white and ginger Cavalier, in Whistler's Alpine neighbourhood. Robert and his dog were last seen on video surveillance footage from a neighboring construction site at the end of Alpine Way, where Robert entered the trail but did not exit. Robert was also suffering from dementia, and he has not been seen or heard from since.

During the course of their trip to the village of Denare Beach, the trio encountered turbulent waters, which caused William to fall overboard. In an attempt to rescue him, Raymond dove into the water. Both men were last seen submerged in the water.

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2025030773.CaseDesc: John Edwards was last seen at around 16:00 on 11 June 2025, leaving St. Joseph's Villa in Dundas, Ontario. He was walking south on Milgrove Side Road, heading away from Highway 6 in Flamborough. The distance from this location to the villa is approximately 10.3 km. John has cognitive impairments resembling dementia and is considered vulnerable. Due to the unpredictability of his movements and the recent heatwave, the police are extremely concerned for his safety. There is currently no evidence of foul play, and the Hamilton Police Service is appealing to the public and businesses for CCTV and dash cam footage.

Case reference: 2014003349.CaseDesc: On March 14, 1993, Carl Berg Ellingsen was seen for the last time with his family at his residence in the East Vancouver region of British Columbia. Carl has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2010000499.CaseDesc: David Kruger was running a business with another individual, and was experiencing financial difficulties. On April 26, 1979, David was last seen by his business partner, who reported him missing on May 2, 1979. He has not been seen or heard from since. His mother had died approximately 3 weeks prior, so it is possible he may have been feeling despondent. He was last seen at his residence in Guelph, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004174.CaseDesc: On October 31, 1979, Larry Warner last made contact with his father and was said to be of no fixed address in Niagara Falls, Ontario. In February 1991, his family reported him missing to the police, having not heard from him for several years. In 1979, it was reported that Larry was feeling despondent.

Scar: Right Foot, From a severe laceration

Case reference: 2012020002.CaseDesc: Perry Sebastian was last seen December 26, 2011. Perry is from the Hagwilget First Nations reserve and reported missing from the Southbank area of Burns Lake, British Columbia. He was reportedly despondent.

Case reference: 2014004965.CaseDesc: Cecilia Nikal arrived in Vancouver to visit her mother on August 1, 1989; she then left her mother's house to live on the streets. She was last seen by her mother in October of 1989. A report by a family member that Ms. Nikal had subsequently moved to Vancouver Island was never confirmed.

Case reference: 2021019974.CaseDesc: On May 18, 2021, Jason Lambert was reported missing by his family.  Jason was last seen on or about April 16, 2021, departing from a residence in Oliver, British Columbia.  Jason has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2018053566.CaseDesc: On September 26, 1995, at approximately 8:30am, Robert Walmsley was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Robert was scheduled to meet with his sister the following day, but did not show up.

Case reference: 2014005455.CaseDesc: Mildred Nelson (née Flett) was last seen on June 20, 2010 in the downtown area of Winnipeg, Manitoba.  It is highly unusual for Mildred to be out of contact with her family and friends.

Case reference: 2006019099.CaseDesc: Janet Derbyshire was last seen on December 4, 1976, in St. Joseph Island near Sault Ste. Marie, ON.  She was seen jumping off the St. Joseph's Island Bridge into the water. She was seen floating downstream for approximately .25 miles (400 m) before she submerged under water. Janet is presumed drowned but her body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2009002599.CaseDesc: Mark Mayhew was residing with family at a residence in Sturgeon Falls, Ontario. He left overnight without notice on November 30, 1973. There had been no incident to provoke his departure. Mark was on foot and had no known destination.

Teeth: False, No teeth; had false teeth but was not wearing them at the time.

Case reference: 2020001488.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1988, Edward Parsons was seen for the last time as he was dragged from his apartment by a street gang in Toronto, Ontario. Edward was taken to a beach where he was violently assaulted, and buried in a shallow grave. The police were informed of this incident, and attended the grave. Upon their arrival, the alleged burial site was found empty.

Case reference: 2014002473.CaseDesc: On July 4, 1991, Gabriel Bukredji was seen for the last time in the Saint-Leonard district of Montreal, Quebec. Gabriel was despondent and had also mentioned he was interested in purchasing property in another country.

Case reference: 2014003895.CaseDesc: On April 30, 1993, the RCMP were informed that Diana Thomas had fallen through the ice and not resurfaced. She was a passenger on a snowmobile with her mother and a 13-year-old driver. The trio was about 10 metres from shore on Gods River, Shamattawa, Manitoba, when the snowmobile broke through the ice. Despite attempts to recover her, these met with negative results.

Case reference: 2014002145.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1975, William Garson, his father, his brother and a friend set out for a hunt in Moose Lake, Manitoba. On September 14, other hunters found gas cans and a thermos with the Garson name on it. These hunters reported their findings to the police.  A search was initiated and police found a boat sitting upright on the bottom of the lake. The depth of the lake around the boat was only 8 to 10 feet. Police believe the men encountered extremely rough water while crossing Moose Lake. The motors were found to be in forward gear. There was no flotation gear in the boat and it was heavily loaded with camping and hunting equipment. All bodies recovered except William, presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2014006747.CaseDesc: Jian Ping Li and her 6 month old baby, Xiao Feng Lu, were last seen at their family residence around 9:40 a.m in Brossard, Quebec on April 30, 2014.  When her husband returned that day, around 2:30 p.m., there was nobody home and the back door was unlocked.  Jian Ping Li's car was still at the residence, however she left without her purse, wallet, credit card, cell phone, money, as well as the diaper bag, the stroller and the car seat for the baby.

Case reference: 2014002267.CaseDesc: On April 11, 1992, Pawel Gazdzicki was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Pawel was despondent, suffered from mental health issues, and may have lost his memory. He had mentioned wanting to jump off of the Champlain Bridge.

Case reference: 2012020044.CaseDesc: On December 23, 1986, Rodney Sloat was seen for the last time, by his friends, in Strathcona County, Alberta. That evening, Rodney was having dinner at his friends’ residence, and had left on his snowmobile at approximately midnight. During the time of his disappearance, Rodney may have been despondent. All of his personal belongings, identification, and snowmobile were found at his residence.

Case reference: 2014001698.CaseDesc: Glenn Fry was last seen at his residence in Delta, British Columbia, on February 14, 2000. Glenn has not been seen or heard from since that time.

Case reference: 2008005999.CaseDesc: On September 8, 1978, Brian McLean and his co-worker, Russell Thomas, were commercial fishing at their camp on MacDowell Lake, near MacDowell Lake First Nation Territory. Russell advised that they left in separate boats to lift nets. He went to the west side of the lake and pulled four nets, then to the east side of the lake and lifted two more nets. He then realized that Brian was not there. Russell headed back towards the camp and found Brian's boat washed up against the shore approximately three or four hundred metres from the camp. The motor was in forward gear with the throttle off, and the paddle was missing from the boat. MacDowell Lake is 90 "air miles" north of Red Lake, and is accessible only by air. The area was searched, and the lake was dragged, but Brian McLean has not been found.

Pants: Oilskin, Green, Coveralls with blue suspenders
Amputation: Right Foot, all toes except big toe left

Case reference: 2024005411.CaseDesc: Euguene Wemigwans was last seen on August 23, 2023 when he was transferred to the Victoria Hospital in London, Ontario.  Hospital records show that Euguene was discharged from the hospital on August 24, 2023.  His sister reported him as missing on February 1, 2024.

Case reference: 2014002407.CaseDesc: On  June 27, 1973, Robert Scott Ellis and a friend went fishing on Reed Lake in Manitoba. They left in the morning around 9:30 a.m. and fished until about 6:00 p.m. when they decided to return home. As the day progressed, the weather deteriorated and the water became quite rough. They began to take on water over the sides of the canoe. Despite the progress they were making, the canoe was finally rolled over by a wave. Both men held on to the canoe for hours, but Robert eventually got tired and let go.  When the friend finally reached shore, he reported the incident. A drag and dive operation was launched, but the results were negative. It is presumed that Robert drowned.

Case reference: 2014004667.CaseDesc: On  November 25, 1999, the Gypsumville RCMP detachment received a report of an aircraft in distress over Lake Winnipeg near Reindeer Island, Manitoba. The aircraft, a single-engine Cherokee 140, was carrying three people; the pilot and two passengers. The pilot had declared that the engine had stalled and that he was trying to reach Reindeer Island. He then stated that he was going into the water. Two RCMP and an Air Search and Rescue Hercules aircrafts conducted an aerial search. It was not possible to search the lake by boat as there was too much ice on the lake. All three are presumed dead from drowning or the impact of the crash.

Case reference: 2013000099.CaseDesc: William Andersen and a co-worker were designated to conduct a wildlife survey in northern Manitoba. The men had flown into North Indian Lake on June 26th and departed by canoe from there. On the second day when the men attempted to shoot some rapids, their canoe hit a rock which overturned, throwing both men into the river. William was not seen again. Air and land searches failed to locate William and he is presumed dead as a result of drowning. No foul play is suspected in this matter.

It was determined to be that of a robust male, size 10 shoe, big boned and athletic, likely between the ages of 30 and 60.

Case reference: 2021037317.CaseDesc: On 18 August, 2021, Kari Campbell was seen for the last time in the Durham Bridge region of York County, New Brunswick. Kari has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2005005699.CaseDesc: On June 22, 1991, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from the Niagara River between Horseshoe Falls and the "Maid of the Mist" boat docks. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 113 lbs, however this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Teeth: Several amalgam fillings in his teeth and multiple posterior teeth in his upper and lower jaw were lost/removed prior to death.

Case reference: 2005004599.CaseDesc: On August 22, 1996, an unidentified man, believed to be Caucasian was recovered from the Sir Adam Beck Dam in the Niagara River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 145 lbs and his length was measured at 5'10" to 5’11”, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He has evidence of heart disease and may have had heart problems in the past. It is estimated that he had been in the water for a few days up to two weeks prior to discovery. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts that this unidentified male is of European ancestry.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Long, Long grey and white beard 12cm
Teeth: No upper teeth and no lower posterior teeth; remaining teeth have roots only; crowns are lost due to decay.

Case reference: 2023053313.CaseDesc: Kyle Hancock was last seen in St. Thomas, Ontario, on August 2, 2023. Kyle's phone hasn't been connected to any network since he was last observed, and his bank account hasn't been accessed.

Case reference: 2014005600.CaseDesc: Robert Seguin was reported missing on October 25, 1997, by his family, who had not seen him for a number of weeks.  His vehicle was subsequently located the next day in the area of Langmuir Rd, Timmins, Ontario.  Despite extensive efforts by the Timmins Search and Rescue, the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) and the Timmins Police Service Canine Unit, Robert was not located.

Case reference: 2014006505.CaseDesc: On March 10, 2014, Sandra Mensah was seen for the last time in the Cartierville district of Montreal, Quebec. Her boyfriend came to pick her up at her home during the evening. Sandra has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002337.CaseDesc: Timothy Peifer was last seen during the long weekend in September 2002 in the Caddy Lake area of Manitoba.  Timothy's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2020011116.CaseDesc: Glen Peddle had been hitchhiking through the United States between 1982 and 1985. In April 1985, Glen called his mother from New York to tell her that he was planning on returning home to Newfoundland in the spring, but never returned home.

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Jewelry: Wood, rope around the neck with wooden cross
Socks: White, Grey, white top and grey on bottom
Tattoo: Right Shoulder, sword and a cross
Left Hand, Text "Ozzy", one letter on each finger

Case reference: 2017008453.CaseDesc: On September 7, 2015, Lorne Parkes was last seen in Kelowna, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014003808.CaseDesc: On June 10, 1979, Edward McMichael was seen for the last time when he was staying at the YMCA in downtown Vancouver, British-Columbia. He previously travelled to the Yukon and Alberta and worked in the mining industry.
